description:
This policy setting allows you to configure Microsoft Word to retain file path information when you work with files on a network server, either as a mapped drive (Z:\Folder_Name\File_Name) or as Universal Naming Convention (UNC) (\\Share_Name\File_Name).

If you enable this policy setting, you may select one of these options:
- Use Drive letter or UNC as entered
- Convert Drive letter to UNC
- Convert UNC to Drive letter

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the default option is "Use Drive letter or UNC as entered."
